params.prompt: Editorial macro photograph of a tilt-shift miniature diorama on a light grey desk, HO-scale model figurines. Three small white cardboard boxes in a row, each with a neat black label «ФОП», are connected by turquoise threads to one large printed bank statement sheet with a header «ВИПИСКА З РАХУНКУ» and columns of numbers. Two tiny figures in dark suits look along the threads through a big magnifying glass; one tiny figure with a clipboard follows a thread. Soft daylight, calm, precise, tidy, white paper, light grey, graphite details, turquoise #30D5C8 as the only accent colour.
